r13_contract.comparisonModel: IF ship_category IN {'A','B'} AND construction_date >= '2017-01-01', THEN for every applicable loading condition either residual_stability_factor_s_i = 1 or, where the SOLAS II-1/4.1 alternative applies, alternative_instrument_residual_stability_status = compliant.

directCheckSubconstraints.description: Each external loading-condition result satisfies the factor or permitted alternative-instrument outcome.

r13_contract.formulaExpression: For every loadingConditionCase, residualStabilityFactorSI = 1 unless alternativeInstrumentApplicable is true and alternativeInstrumentResidualStabilityStatus is compliant for that case.
r13_contract.informationalSourceFormula: For every loadingConditionCase, residualStabilityFactorSI = 1 unless alternativeInstrumentApplicable is true and alternativeInstrumentResidualStabilityStatus is compliant for that case.
r13_contract.verificationPolicyBasis: The category policy is based on the source requirement and intrinsic verification method. It is independent of whether any particular LLM model previously succeeded or failed to generate a SHACL shape.

test_cases.rationale: Applicable standard route with complete R13 readiness interface.
Alternative-instrument route with compliant result interface.
Deliberately formula/value-inconsistent residual factor retained as PASS: R13 marks this COMPLEX_READINESS with formulaExecutionRequired=false.
Category C lies outside A/B damaged-stability cohort.
Pre-2017 construction lies outside applicability cohort.
Applicable ship has no loading-condition readiness case.
Alternative instrument route represented as non-compliant.
Required loading-condition result evidence path missing.
Result evidence attached to ship instead of loadingConditionCase.
Universal readiness fails when one represented loading condition has no valid route.

benchmark_policy: Source/R13-defined behavioral oracle created without inspecting generated SHACL.
